main_text.l: ORATIO DE REMOVENDIS PARERGIS ET NITORE CONCILIANDO DISCIPLINIS.
Quam dixit Lugduni Batav., cum Lectiones publicas in Logicam auspicaretur.
Nitor & intaminata puritas, Charitum prima gratia est: hic Achelojus ille fons est, quo illæ lavantur: Sordent Gratia

page.notes: The large woodcut initial N is joined to the word "Nitor" in the transcription. The italic lines of the subtitle are set as a foot line for clarity. The word after "Sordent" continues on the next page ("Gra-" hyphenated at line end). Partial margin text on the right edge belongs to the adjacent page and is not transcribed. The top of the scan shows a "Quast." marginal heading on the facing page only.
